title: "pupilAvg_vs_xyvar_comparison"
output: html_document
date: "2026-04-27"
---

Compare original vs gaze-regressed pupil signals and their associations with arousal (VR study 1 and fMRI study 3 only).

### VR study 1 (vrmid1) — example participant timecourse overlay

```{r}
example_sub <- vrmid1_pupil_data %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>%
  summarise(n_arousal = sum(!is.na(arousal)),
            n_both_signal = sum(!is.na(pupil_Avg_scaled) & !is.na(pupil_Avg_xyvar_scaled)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_arousal > 20, n_both_signal > 500) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_arousal), desc(n_both_signal)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(Subject)

example_df <- vrmid1_pupil_data %>%
  filter(Subject == example_sub,
         sample_in_trial_t >= 0,
         Time_sec >= 0, trial< 5) %>%
  select(Subject, trial, sample_in_trial_t, arousal_start, Time,
         pupil_Avg_scaled, pupil_Avg_xyvar_scaled) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pupil_Avg_scaled, pupil_Avg_xyvar_scaled),
               names_to = "signal",
               values_to = "pupil_value")

ggplot(example_df,
       aes(x = sample_in_trial_t, y = pupil_value, color = signal)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("pupil_Avg_scaled" = "steelblue4",
                                "pupil_Avg_xyvar_scaled" = "firebrick3")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = paste0("VR study 1 — example participant: ", example_sub),
       x = "Sample index (continuous)",
       y = "Scaled pupil",
       color = "Signal")+
  facet_wrap(~trial)
```

### fMRI study 3 (fmri3) — example participant timecourse overlay

```{r}
example_sub_fmri <- fmri3_pupil_data %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  summarise(n_arousal = sum(!is.na(arousal)),
            n_both_signal = sum(!is.na(pupilDiameter_scaled) & !is.na(pupilDiameter_xyvar_scaled)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_arousal > 20, n_both_signal > 500) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_arousal), desc(n_both_signal)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(subject)

example_df_fmri <- fmri3_pupil_data %>%
  filter(subject == example_sub_fmri,
         sample_in_trial_t >= 0,
         Time_sec >= 0, trial<5) %>%
  select(subject, trial, sample_in_trial_t, times, Time_sec,
         pupilDiameter_scaled, pupilDiameter_xyvar_scaled) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pupilDiameter_scaled, pupilDiameter_xyvar_scaled),
               names_to = "signal",
               values_to = "pupil_value")

ggplot(example_df_fmri,
       aes(x = sample_in_trial_t, y = pupil_value, color = signal)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("pupilDiameter_scaled" = "steelblue4",
                                "pupilDiameter_xyvar_scaled" = "firebrick3")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = paste0("fMRI study 3 — example participant: ", example_sub_fmri),
       x = "Sample index (continuous)",
       y = "Scaled pupil",
       color = "Signal")+
  facet_wrap(~trial)
```

## LMER comparison by study (parallel to s4a style)

### anticipation
```{r}
# vrmid1
vrmid1_xy_ant <- vrmid1_pupil_data %>%
  filter(
    probe == "anti",
    sample_in_trial_t <= vrmid1_ant_window[2],
    sample_in_trial_t > vrmid1_ant_window[1]
  ) %>%
  group_by(Subject, trial) %>%
  summarise(mean_pupil_xyvar = mean(pupil_Avg_xyvar_scaled, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

da <- vrmid1_data_antprobe %>%
  select(Subject, trial, condition, arousal_scaled, mean_pupil_nobc_ant) %>%
  rename(mean_pupil_avg = mean_pupil_nobc_ant) %>%
  left_join(vrmid1_xy_ant, by = c("Subject", "trial")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(arousal_scaled), !is.na(mean_pupil_avg), !is.na(mean_pupil_xyvar))

summary(avg <- lmer(scale(arousal_scaled) ~ scale(mean_pupil_avg) + (1 | Subject) + (1 | condition), da))
summary(xy <- lmer(scale(arousal_scaled) ~ scale(mean_pupil_xyvar) + (1 | Subject) + (1 | condition), da))

r.squaredGLMM(avg)
r.squaredGLMM(xy)
```

### both probes
```{r}
# vrmid1
vrmid1_xy_both <- bind_rows(
  vrmid1_xy_ant %>% mutate(probe_model = "anti"),
  vrmid1_xy_out %>% mutate(probe_model = "out")
) %>% mutate(probe_model = factor(probe_model, levels = c("anti", "out")))

db <- vrmid1_data_2probes %>%
  select(Subject, trial, probe, condition, arousal_scaled, mean_pupil_nobc) %>%
  mutate(probe_model = factor(probe, levels = c("anti", "out"))) %>%
  rename(mean_pupil_avg = mean_pupil_nobc) %>%
  left_join(vrmid1_xy_both, by = c("Subject", "trial", "probe_model")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(arousal_scaled), !is.na(mean_pupil_avg), !is.na(mean_pupil_xyvar))

summary(avg <- lmer(scale(arousal_scaled) ~ scale(mean_pupil_avg) + (1 | Subject) + (1 | condition) + (1 | probe_model), db))
summary(xy <- lmer(scale(arousal_scaled) ~ scale(mean_pupil_xyvar) + (1 | Subject) + (1 | condition) + (1 | probe_model), db))

r.squaredGLMM(avg)
r.squaredGLMM(xy)
```

## pool the effect sizes and make summary plots
```{r}
# trial-level pooled data (anticipation)
data_antprobe <- bind_rows(
  vrmid1_data_antprobe %>%
    select(Subject, trial, condition, arousal_scaled, mean_pupil_nobc_ant) %>%
    rename(mean_pupil_avg = mean_pupil_nobc_ant) %>%
    left_join(vrmid1_xy_ant, by = c("Subject", "trial")) %>%
    mutate(study = "VRStudy"),
  fmri3_data_antprobe %>%
    select(subject, trial, cue_size, arousal_scaled, mean_pupil_nobc_scaled_ant) %>%
    rename(mean_pupil_avg = mean_pupil_nobc_scaled_ant) %>%
    left_join(fmri3_xy_ant, by = c("subject", "trial")) %>%
    rename(Subject = subject, condition = cue_size) %>%
    mutate(study = "FMRIStudy")
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(arousal_scaled), !is.na(mean_pupil_avg), !is.na(mean_pupil_xyvar)) %>%
  ungroup()

# trial-level pooled data (outcome)
data_outprobe <- bind_rows(
  vrmid1_data_outprobe %>%
    select(Subject, trial, condition, arousal_scaled, mean_pupil_nobc_out) %>%
    rename(mean_pupil_avg = mean_pupil_nobc_out) %>%
    left_join(vrmid1_xy_out, by = c("Subject", "trial")) %>%
    mutate(study = "VRStudy"),
  fmri3_data_outprobe %>%
    select(subject, trial, cue_size, arousal_scaled, mean_pupil_nobc_scaled_out) %>%
    rename(mean_pupil_avg = mean_pupil_nobc_scaled_out) %>%
    left_join(fmri3_xy_out, by = c("subject", "trial")) %>%
    rename(Subject = subject, condition = cue_size) %>%
    mutate(study = "FMRIStudy")
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(arousal_scaled), !is.na(mean_pupil_avg), !is.na(mean_pupil_xyvar)) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_dat <- bind_rows(
  data_antprobe %>% mutate(probe = "Anticipation"),
  data_outprobe %>% mutate(probe = "Outcome")
) %>%
  mutate(
    study = recode(study, VRStudy = "VR", FMRIStudy = "fMRI"),
    study = factor(study, levels = c("VR", "fMRI"))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_pupil_avg, mean_pupil_xyvar),
    names_to = "signal",
    values_to = "pupil_value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    signal = recode(signal,
                    mean_pupil_avg = "Original",
                    mean_pupil_xyvar = "XYvar"),
    signal = factor(signal, levels = c("Original", "XYvar")),
    probe = factor(probe, levels = c("Anticipation", "Outcome"))
  )

ggplot(plot_dat, aes(x = pupil_value, y = arousal_scaled, color = signal)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.22, size = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1) +
  facet_grid(probe ~ study, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Original" = "steelblue4", "XYvar" = "firebrick3")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "z-scored pupil size",
    y = "z-scored arousal rating",
    color = "Signal"
  )
# ggsave("~/Desktop/VRMID-analysis/mid-pupil/figures/fig4c_pooled_effects_xyvar.tiff", dpi = 300, height = 6, width = 8)
# ggsave("~/Desktop/VRMID-analysis/mid-pupil/figures/fig4c_pooled_effects_xyvar.png", dpi = 300, height = 6, width = 8)
```

```{r}
get_model_stats <- function(dat, predictor, study_label, probe_label) {
  if (study_label == "VR") {
    fit <- lmer(
      as.formula(paste0("scale(arousal_scaled) ~ scale(", predictor, ") + (1|Subject) + (1|condition)")),
      dat
    )
  } else {
    fit <- lmer(
      as.formula(paste0("scale(arousal_scaled) ~ scale(", predictor, ") + (1|subject) + (1|cue_size)")),
      dat
    )
  }

  cf <- summary(fit)$coefficient
  r2 <- r.squaredGLMM(fit)

  data.frame(
    probe = probe_label,
    study = study_label,
    signal = ifelse(predictor == "mean_pupil_avg", "Original", "XYvar"),
    beta = unname(cf[2, "Estimate"]),
    p_value = unname(cf[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]),
    R2m = unname(r2[1]),
    R2c = unname(r2[2])
  )
}

vr_ant <- data_antprobe %>% filter(study == "VRStudy")
fmri_ant <- data_antprobe %>% filter(study == "FMRIStudy") %>% rename(subject = Subject, cue_size = condition)
vr_out <- data_outprobe %>% filter(study == "VRStudy")
fmri_out <- data_outprobe %>% filter(study == "FMRIStudy") %>% rename(subject = Subject, cue_size = condition)

model_table <- bind_rows(
  get_model_stats(vr_ant, "mean_pupil_avg", "VR", "Anticipation"),
  get_model_stats(vr_ant, "mean_pupil_xyvar", "VR", "Anticipation"),
  get_model_stats(fmri_ant, "mean_pupil_avg", "fMRI", "Anticipation"),
  get_model_stats(fmri_ant, "mean_pupil_xyvar", "fMRI", "Anticipation"),
  get_model_stats(vr_out, "mean_pupil_avg", "VR", "Outcome"),
  get_model_stats(vr_out, "mean_pupil_xyvar", "VR", "Outcome"),
  get_model_stats(fmri_out, "mean_pupil_avg", "fMRI", "Outcome"),
  get_model_stats(fmri_out, "mean_pupil_xyvar", "fMRI", "Outcome")
) %>%
  mutate(
    p_value = signif(p_value, 3),
    beta = round(beta, 3),
    R2m = round(R2m, 3),
    R2c = round(R2c, 3)
  ) %>%
  arrange(probe, study, signal)

model_table %>%
  kable() %>%
  kable_styling()
```
